description.narrative: The goal of this cultural exchange activity is to include youth with disabilities in the cultural activity of music/dance/drama and art. Gjøvik kunst & kulturskole wants to strive towards giving people with disabilities, and especially young people with disabilities equal access to cultural activties in the poorest neigbourhoods of Santo Domingo in The dominican republic. This activity will be organised in colaboration with Asociacion Dominicana de Rehabilitacion (ADR), the music school Centro de Educacion Musical Moderna (CEMM) as well as the Ministry of education and the Ministry of culture.
